ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, checking and analysis; no AI commit-attribution trailers.
assessment: Scientific status remains EXPLORATORY. Integrity controls may PASS. Assess every fixed model and learning curve, including adverse/degenerate results. No model or feature selection from outcomes. Full exact guard oracle is the target definition, not evidence of a discovery. The stratum baseline prevents credit for simply rediscovering necessary gain geometry.
attribution: Every RESULT retains all original data/words/PINS.json credits and the complete historical source provenance. PR2853, Mason Hale PR2917, Marius-Paul Dumitrean PR2979 and retained predecessor/toolkit/auditor authors remain credited.
changed_premise: Replace selected-success PR-level regression with an outcome-enriched, probability-weighted candidate corpus including gains, ties, losses, and illegal proposals. Previously closed constructor domains are not reopened.
confirmation: Both execution seeds reproduce the same canonical corpus and deterministic observed models/learning curves/unshuffled benchmark. Shuffle sequences are separately seeded. Repeated computation never increases the number of independent observations.
controls: Unchanged complete literal fills/profile/mass/physical family/window audits for all three historical sources.
Known admitted PR2917 exchange and independent direct literal-predicate checks.
Synthetic beneficial, harmful, equal-width tie, same-bin tie, capacity, window and family cases.
Exact S versus uniform union coverage and probabilities; canonical pair and source binding; identical corpus under two execution traversals.
Weighted ranking tie/perfect/reversed controls, train-only preprocessing, prior correction, nested label-blind panels and within-stratum shuffle counts.
Full sources, stable physical call/family endpoint split, and explicitly chronological-index pair-purge sensitivity.

data_protocol.S: Distinct bins, unequal widths, both post-swap capacities feasible, d*(ra-rb+d)>0; no window/family selection.
data_protocol.call_group_identity: stage*74+replica; stable physical call identity across historical chronological orders. core call_gap remains chronological.
data_protocol.domain_order: Lexicographic call pair (ta<tb), then helperA, helperB; canonical role i=408*t+h.
data_protocol.lineage_scope: All three fills share substantial word/template ancestry; held-source validation is not held-ancestry validation.
data_protocol.pair_purge_identity: Canonical time/helper coordinates only; this sensitivity is not a physical role identity match when order or provider layouts differ.
data_protocol.scientific_scope: Historical exact owner-exchange outcome prediction; no new construction or native/outer admission.
data_protocol.shards: Earlier canonical role call //8; all 84 shards, including empty shards, are recorded.

feature_schema.core_scope: Prospective temporal/role/physical-graph descriptors; no widths, ranks, residuals, costs, labels or IDs.
feature_schema.full_oracle: legal AND gain_sign==1; an exact diagnostic upper bound, not a trainable predictor.
feature_schema.gain_sign: For legal pairs only: +1 strict concave-moment improvement, 0 tie, -1 harm. Illegal gain_sign is 0.
feature_schema.mechanism_scope: Explicitly width/residual/capacity-derived comparator; not rank-free ML.

model_protocol.features: core rank/price-free columns; optional six width/residual/capacity columns explicitly cost-derived
model_protocol.joint_split: same global salted hash namespace for call IDs and physical-family IDs; train all four endpoints in side0, test all four in side1; discard mixed rows
model_protocol.pair_purge: remove from other-fill training every canonical role pair present anywhere in held-out fill before sampling; report degeneration
model_protocol.permutation_null: Within each fixed source-fill x S-flag benchmark-panel block, shuffle exact binary labels, keeping pairs/features/weights and block class counts fixed. One-class blocks unchanged. Tests conditional within-block feature-label association in this finite related lineage only.
model_protocol.permutation_reporting: unshuffled matched benchmark and 2000 indexed shuffle statistics; no p/q, pattern, independence, causal or best-model claim
model_protocol.permutation_secondary_statistic: same Brier difference against train-within-S prevalence and zero outsideS; guards against credit merely for identifying the necessary-gain stratum
model_protocol.permutation_statistic: mean over three held-out fills of weighted Brier(training mean)-weighted Brier(model), separately core_linear/core_quadratic
model_protocol.preprocessing: train-only inverse-inclusion-weighted means/scales; clip standardized x to [-8,8]; quadratic appends x*x; no feature selection
model_protocol.relatedness: Three allocations share ancestry; entire-fill holdout is a sensitivity, not independent replication.
model_protocol.subsampling: label-blind fixed salted SplitMix64 pair hash, choose smallest hashes; include exact N/n retention factor; no adaptive cap
model_protocol.target: legal AND gain_sign==+1; strict exact complete-profile improvement, not kappa admission
model_protocol.training_weights: inverse inclusion and label-blind subsampling; balance each class to one half for fitting; restore training population-prior log odds at prediction

pattern_criteria: All five PLAN section6 criteria remain required. This related historical corpus and cost-derived mechanism comparator do not satisfy them; no formal pattern, p-value, q-value, causal effect or kappa claim will be promoted. The 2000 shuffles per seed are descriptive matched benchmarks only.
publication: Only authored small commits and push to mdumitrean/integer-mult-bounds:research/styles-r11-results. No PRs, comments, discussions, or other GitHub writes.

queue.policy: All independent tasks of a phase are queued to the single common pool; successful validation advances automatically. No discretionary pause between batches.

resources.preparation_projection: Project parent corpus/array memory before allocation; project complete pool peak before every launch. Record measured RSS/PSS and CPU/core-equivalents separately from configured workers.

scope: Retrospective exact owner-exchange prediction across three related historical T74 allocations. This measures screening associations and their limits; it does not construct or admit a new kappa improvement, establish causality, or provide independent-lineage evidence.
stop_rules: A failed control, missing shard, storage/memory projection failure, task error/timeout or budget cutoff stops dependent work and preserves partial receipts. No silent retries or outcome-driven domain/model changes. At most one separately registered changed-premise pivot this round; two consecutive scientific nulls stop their lane. Prior string/constructor/growth stops remain in force.
